issuer: the Queensland Department of Transport and Main Roads (TMR)
note: TMR's fees page (costs as at 1 July 2026, read 2026-10-30) gives a 5-year driver licence at $212.00 (1 to 4 years also sold) and a photo identification card at $82.70. The open licence page says one must be at least 20 for an open licence, so it is kept from 20. The photo card's term and youngest age weren't read (its page wasn't reached), so the term is null and the card has no age.

sources.title: Queensland Government, Open licence
sources.said: You must be at least 20 years old to be eligible for an open driver licence.
